identitySignals: Name match: the agenda's "Diamond Equine Services" is the same name used by the Oakland business at diamondequineservices.com.
Location match: the agenda gives Oakland, CA. The organization's website lists 13560 Skyline Blvd., Oakland, CA 94619.

Program match: the website says it runs horsemanship and riding programs for Oakland youth. That fits an OUSD Workplace Training Partners MOU for the Exploring College, Career, and Community Options (ECCCO) program.
No other organization with this name turned up in the searches.
research.notes: I did not check the California Secretary of State, IRS or SAM.gov registries, so the EIN, entity number and UEI are null. The legal entity type is unconfirmed, so orgType is null. It could be an LLC, a corporation or a sole proprietorship, and the website names a related nonprofit, the Metropolitan Equestrian Preservation Society. "Diamond Equine Services" is the trade name shown on the website. The registered legal name may differ. The email is a general Gmail inbox shown on the website's contact page. I did not find a page tying this vendor directly to OUSD.

profile.summary: Diamond Equine Services is the concessionaire that manages Oakland City Stables, a 7.2-acre site on Skyline Boulevard in the Oakland hills. It offers horse boarding, training and lessons. It also runs horsemanship and riding programs for Oakland youth, veterans and therapeutic riding.

sources.title: Diamond Equine Services – City Stables | Oakland, CA

review.notes: I fetched all three cited pages. They show Diamond Equine Services as the concessionaire of Oakland City Stables at 13560 Skyline Blvd., Oakland, with the listed phone number and a general business email, and with youth horsemanship programs that fit an OUSD workplace-training MOU, so the name, city and services all match. The summary repeats the site's own wording about the 7.2-acre site, the services offered and the youth, veteran and therapeutic programs, and it stays neutral; legalName is only the trade name shown on the site and may not be the registered name.
